composition.coaching_note: Agent: 'I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?' The agent should have asked for the customer's consent to send the Scope of Appointment via email. Ask for consent to send the Scope of Appointment via email next time to ensure compliance.
composition.summary: The call was compliant with CMS contract year 2027 marketing rules. The TPMO disclaimer was delivered prior to discussing any benefits, and the Scope of Appointment was collected before the plan discussion. No superlatives were used, and the call was scheduled for a follow-up review.
